newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico mortgage restructurings total almost 90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico mortgage restructurings total almost 90 pct.

text.p: To the close of September, only 90,000 Mexican mortages of a total of 893,000 in the market have not been restructured in inflation-linked investment units, a source from the Association of Mexican Bankers said Wednesday.
The source, who asked to remaim anonymous, said the percentage of restructured credits was approaching 90 percent.
To stop defaults on home loans because of high peso interest rates, Mexico's government has offered mortgage owners to restructure their debts in inflation-indexed units of investments called UDIS
The government extended the deadline for restructuring on September 30 to the end of the year in a bid to persuade even more home owners to switch into UDI units from pesos.
